title: The dot field loads after the hero, paints behind it and settles, or holds still under reduced motion
intent: The hero heading and install commands show while the field is still loading; the field's canvas is decorative, sized to the hero and inside the page; under normal motion it runs, paints dots other than the ground and settles, and under reduced motion it is one still frame.
preconditions: The browser has WebGL, on Chromium's software renderer, enabled at launch.
The browser context reports the variant's motion preference before the page loads.

steps.action: Load /install and let the browser go idle.
steps.expect: The field's chunk is never requested.

The hero heading and the install commands are visible while the hero's data-field is still loading, the hero paints before the field draws, the heading is the largest contentful paint, and the field arrives as one chunk under 6 KB gzipped.
It is aria-hidden, out of the tab order, takes no pointer events, matches the hero's box and leaves the document within the one-pixel fit.

steps.action: Under normal motion, wait for the field.
steps.expect: data-field reaches running, the hero paints pixels other than the surface colour, and data-field reaches settled within a bounded wait.

steps.action: Under reduced motion, wait for the field and capture the hero twice, a frame apart.
steps.expect: data-field is still, and the two captures are identical.
